purpose: Output-coupling Gamma_s extraction and rho-only proxy vs full R_g comparison. Tests whether Phase C-2's sigma_g ∝ (1 - rho_g) profile is a faithful approximation of the Paper C bit allocator or whether Gamma_s extraction is required.
label: Mamba-2.8B-hf
verdict: FULL R_g IS REQUIRED. Global log-log Pearson(R_proxy, R_full) = 0.635 < 0.7. The Gamma_s coupling carries information that the rho-only proxy throws away. Phase C-2's approximation is materially wrong; future runs must extract Gamma during calibration and use the full sigma_g ∝ sqrt((1 - rho_g) / Gamma_s) profile.
